name: Moonlight ~Omoide no Hajimari~
source:
School that hero attended is going to be closed down. There are only two months left to say proper goodbyes to the classmates. 
Every hour of this time with the most important people should be cherished.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公就读的学校即将关闭。距离与同学们郑重道别只剩两个月。
与最重要的人共同度过的每一刻，都值得珍惜。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
